question: What local business tax rate is assessed on the annual gross interest and commission income of commercial bank branches?
answer: The local business tax rate assessed on the annual gross interest and commission income of commercial bank branches in Davao City is sixty and half percent (60.50%) of one percent (1%) of the gross receipts of the preceding calendar year, as stated in [S1].
